summary:
15-second live-action cinematic shot for the final battle in Chapter 1 of Fire Emblem: Exiled prince Marth charges with sword toward dark dragon king Medeus, magical flames collide with sword light.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> Fully retained - Marth's live-action facial features, short dark blue hair, golden circlet, blue-gold armor stay consistent all the time.
<Picture 2> Fully retained - Medeus's live-action facial features, bald head, pointed ears, green skin, purple-gold robe, purple flame on right hand stay consistent all the time.

detailed_description:
Live-action movie texture: realistic human skin, natural hair and pores, 35mm film lens, shallow depth of field, dark temple scene, firelight interweaving with purple flames, Rembrandt lighting, subtle film grain. Natural performance by live actors. NOT 3D render, animation, cartoon, CGI, game cutscene or illustration. Inside a medieval dark temple, surrounded by stone pillars, glowing magic array on the ground. Medium close-up and close-up shots throughout, characters occupy the main frame.

[Shot 1] (0s-5s) Medium close-up. Marth is positioned on the left side of the frame, Medeus on the right. Marth grips the holy sword, raises it toward Medeus, and shouts with a determined expression:
Marth: <d>[Chinese] 看我的光之剑！</d>
He then charges forward against backlight, cape billowing, while Medeus watches with cold contempt.

[Shot 2] (5s-10s) Close-up on Medeus. He raises his right hand, purple magic flame surging violently around his palm. He fixes Marth with a grim gaze and replies in a deep, resonant voice:
Medeus: <d>[Chinese] 可笑的王子，黑暗终将吞噬你！</d>
Medeus launches the purple magic flame straight at Marth.



Marth on the left side of frame, Medeus on the right. Strictly forbidden: subtitles, on-screen text, 3D rendering, animation, cartoon, CGI, game cutscenes, illustrations, garbled text.

overall_soundscape:
War drums, roaring purple flames, sword energy hum, heavy metal collision, explosive shockwave, temple reverb.

non_diegetic_music:
Epic battle symphony, dominated by brass and timpani, tense rhythm, rising climax at the final collision.
